units.source_text: 石阶旁边，与其说是围上树篱笆，不如说是雾岛杜鹃团团簇簇，活像一道长堤。

en.t: Beside the stone steps, it was less a hedge enclosing the place than dense clusters of Kirishima azaleas, looking just like a long embankment.

units.source_text: 现在不是杜鹃花期，但它那小嫩叶子的悠悠绿韵，把盛开的郁金香衬托得更加娇艳。

en.t: It was not azalea season now, but the lingering green tone of their small young leaves made the blooming tulips look even more delicate and brilliant.
